research.rule: Stargate production costume and prop references first; no historical WNG apparel

sources.title: Propworx Wraith Drone Uniform, production catalogue record
evidence: black leather under-vest supports hard-rubber silver front and back carapace
silver thigh, knee and shin armour over black leather components
clasps, snaps, zippers, rear lacing and Velcro provide practical fastening logic

sources.title: GateWorld Propworx Stargate auction coverage - Wraith Drone Costume
evidence: Wraith drone/footsoldier costume establishes the warrior-rank armour family

sources.title: Val Halverson Q&A hosted by Joseph Mallozzi
evidence: Wraith wardrobe construction is leather-heavy, practical and texture-driven

required_visual_language: silver hard-rubber grown torso carapace as the dominant armour read
black leather under-vest and flexible jointing visible between shell courses
small practical straps, lacing, clasps and worn edges
organic insect/reptile articulation rather than machine-cut sci-fi panels

external_art_spec.instruction: finished professional painted RimWorld apparel master, not a concept sketch
external_art_spec.silhouette: match vanilla RimWorld PowerArmor proportions; do not invent a human anatomy silhouette
